stories.title: What Did Christa Pike Do? What to Know About the Botched Tennessee Execution.

en.title: What Did Christa Pike Do? What to Know About the Botched Tennessee Execution.
en.summary: Christa Pike, 50, survived two doses of lethal injection during her execution in Tennessee. She was convicted of murdering a classmate in 1995.

stories.title: Supreme Court, Taking On Trump Immigration Agenda, Will Review Migrant Detention Policy

en.title: Supreme Court, Taking On Trump Immigration Agenda, Will Review Migrant Detention Policy
en.summary: The Supreme Court will review the administration's policy of detaining immigrants who entered illegally years ago without bond hearings. Lower courts have disagreed on the policy's legality.

stories.title: Christa Pike appears to survive botched execution attempt in Tennessee, witnesses say

en.title: Christa Pike appears to survive botched execution attempt in Tennessee, witnesses say
en.summary: Christa Pike, 50, reportedly survived her execution attempt in Tennessee. She was sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer.

stories.title: Supreme Court to hear dispute over Trump's mandatory detention policy

en.title: Supreme Court to hear dispute over Trump's mandatory detention policy
en.summary: The Supreme Court will decide whether the Trump administration can detain tens of thousands of immigrants without providing them access to bond hearings.

stories.title: Renée Good’s family sues Trump officials, saying death was ‘not an accident’

en.title: Renée Good's family sues Trump officials, saying death was 'not an accident'
en.summary: The family of a mother of three has initiated legal action against Trump officials following her death. The incident prompted demonstrations and raised questions about federal officers' use of force against immigrants and protesters.

stories.title: Supreme Court agrees to review mandatory ICE detention policy for immigrants

en.title: Supreme Court agrees to review mandatory ICE detention policy for immigrants
en.summary: The Supreme Court has accepted a case concerning mandatory detention requirements for immigrants enforced by ICE. The case is expected to be significant during the upcoming Supreme Court term.

stories.title: Renee Good’s family sues government, top Trump officials and ICE officer who shot her

en.title: Renee Good's family sues government, top Trump officials and ICE officer who shot her
en.summary: The family of Renee Good filed two federal civil lawsuits nine months after an immigration officer fatally shot her in Minneapolis. The lawsuits allege wrongful death and excessive force.

stories.title: Renee Good’s Family Sues ICE Agent and Trump Officials Over Minnesota Killing

en.title: Renee Good's Family Sues ICE Agent and Trump Officials Over Minnesota Killing
en.summary: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by an immigration officer in Minnesota led to protests during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement operations. Her family is pursuing legal action against the agent and officials involved.

stories.title: Supreme Court to decide lawfulness of Trump’s immigrant detention policy

en.title: Supreme Court to decide lawfulness of Trump's immigrant detention policy
en.summary: The Supreme Court will review whether immigrants facing deportation can be held indefinitely in detention while their legal cases proceed.

stories.title: Tennessee cancels executions after Christa Pike survives botched injection

en.title: Tennessee cancels executions after Christa Pike survives botched injection
en.summary: Tennessee halted its remaining executions for the year after an inmate survived two failed lethal injection attempts, with witnesses confirming she remained alive.

stories.title: Cornell Agrees to Outside Investigation of Alleged Gang Rape Case

en.title: Cornell Agrees to Outside Investigation of Alleged Gang Rape Case
en.summary: Cornell University agreed to an external investigation into how it handled an alleged gang rape at a fraternity in 2024 that resulted in no criminal charges.

stories.title: Death Row Inmate Survives Botched Execution in Tennessee

en.title: Death Row Inmate Survives Botched Execution in Tennessee
en.summary: A Tennessee death row inmate survived two lethal injection attempts, prompting the governor to halt all future executions following the state's second execution failure this year.

stories.title: EIA Reports 64-bcf Injection in Natural Gas Storage

en.title: EIA Reports 64-bcf Injection in Natural Gas Storage
en.summary: Natural gas storage received a 64 billion cubic feet injection that matched expectations. Natural gas futures declined following the report.

en.title: Hedge-Fund Managers Lose Out on Lucrative Tax Strategy
en.summary: Appeals court decisions have blocked a method hedge-fund managers used to avoid the 3.8% federal self-employment tax. The rulings close off this previously available tax avoidance approach.

stories.title: Crude Oil Higher on Supply Issues

en.title: Crude Oil Higher on Supply Issues
en.summary: Oil prices declined slightly during early Asian trading hours as crude exports from the Middle East showed signs of increasing. Supply developments influenced the price movement.

en.title: Dollar Hits Near 18-Month High on Prospect of Higher U.S. Rates
en.summary: The dollar reached its strongest level in approximately 18 months against a currency basket, supported by expectations that the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates further.

en.title: America's Copper Hoard Stokes Fear of a Supply Crunch
en.summary: Concerns are rising about potential copper supply constraints related to America's stockpile of the metal. The report also covers developments in European energy initiatives, climate investor interest in data centers, and glacial decline in Switzerland.
